sql: SELECT "death"."caused_by_ship_id" AS k, ("death"."injured" - "death"."killed") AS m1 FROM "death" WHERE ("death"."injured" - "death"."killed") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: people injured - people killed: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one death/attack incident
rank death rows by people injured minus people killed
